title: What Xi and Kim gained from their summit in North Korea
snippet: CSMonitor analysis: Xi sought stability, Kim sought influence. China has recently downplayed 'denuclearization', dropping the term from the official summary of talks. Kim seeks China's acceptance of NK status as nuclear power. Xi's visit is part of a diplomatic charm offensive to boost influence over its socialist ally amid growing NK-Russia ties.
tag_reason: 이전 7일 소스에 동일/유사 항목 없음. CSMonitor의 '중국이 비핵화 용어를 공식 회담 요약에서 삭제' 분석은 새로운 정보
